title: Cyclotron support runs in the site's own account
description:
Relevance and ranking decisions come from a shared service elsewhere.

```gherkin
Feature: Cyclotron in the site's account

  Scenario: Votes train the site's own model
    Given a deployment in its own account
    When editors and readers vote
    Then the site's own model is trained and used
    And no request leaves the account's services
```
